data.body: **[P1] Keep jobs refused while an outstanding suspend can still send.** A resume hook or hook grace timer reaches this assignment even when `_suspend_calls` is nonzero. If client creation is blocked, or botocore is between retries, a job can receive HTTP 202 before the older call sends `SuspendMicrovm`: neither `_call_suspend()` nor its deadline handler checks whether resume invalidated that call. The accepted job can then freeze, while the durable function has stopped redelivering it and waits for its callback timeout. Keep refusal until the outstanding call settles or its remaining requests are prevented. Add regression coverage for resume and grace expiry while a suspend request is still pending.
